implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/packs/PackDetail.tsx: Pack detail view (could be a page at /packs/:id or a Drawer). Uses usePack(id). Sections: (1) Header: name, version, status badge. (2) Manifest: formatted key-value display of pack manifest. (3) Config: key-value table of configuration. (4) Capabilities: Badge list of provided capabilities. (5) Pool assignment: which pool this pack's workers belong to. (6) Health checks: status indicators for pack health. Edit config action (future).
implementationPlan.note: Created PackDetail with sections: Header (name/version/status badge), Manifest (formatted KV), Config (formatted KV), Capabilities (badge list), Pool Assignment, Health Check (status icon). Uses Drawer-compatible layout with ArrowLeft back navigation and X close button. Handles loading skeleton, error state, and empty states for each section.
